endpoint.text: The activities of the peptides were evaluated based on their antioxidant scores, which are based on the presence and position of certain amino acid residues in the peptide sequences [32].
The degree of linoleic acid oxidation was assessed by measuring the optical density at 500 nm at 24-h intervals.

reported_results.text: All values mean ±SD. (a–e) Values with different letters indicated significant differences in the same sample at different times (p < 0.05); (A–D) Values with different letters indicated significant differences in different samples at the same time (p < 0.05).

The results indicated that ATH-II exhibited significantly higher antioxidant activity than ATH and ATH-I (p < 0.05), with EC50 values of 2.21 ± 0.12, 0.58 ± 0.05, and 2.74 ± 0.11 mg/mL for DPPH•, − HO•, and O 2 •, respectively.

EC50 (mg/mL) was defined as the concentration at − which a sample caused a 50% decrease in the initial concentrations of DPPH•, HO•, and O 2 •. (a–e) Values with different letters indicated significant differences in the same sample at different times (p < 0.05).

EC50 (mg/mL) was defined as the concentration at − which a sample caused a 50% decrease in the initial concentrations of DPPH•, HO•, and O 2 •. (a–j) Values with different letters indicated significant differences in the same sample at different times (p < 0.05).
The 13 peptides from Fr.B2 included three tetrapeptides, nine pentapeptides and one decapeptide, and the mean molecular weight was 585.91 kDa.
The 18 peptides from Fr.A3 included five tripeptides, six tetrapeptides, six pentapeptides, and one hexapeptide, and the mean molecular weight was 524.78 kDa based on their theoretical MWs.
